Definition
[Boundary-small relative norm] \group relative-invariant Source: thurston:page-0147

For a compact $3$-manifold with torus boundary, set \[ \| [M,\partial M]\| _0=\liminf _{a\to 0}\{ \| z\| :z\text{ is a straight representative of }[M,\partial M],\ \| \partial z\| \leq a\} . \] This requires $\| [\partial M]\| =0$, which holds for unions of tori.
